provider: UKR.NET Mail — 100 GB per single message, 1024 attachments/message

free_tier.stated: Help wiki states verbatim: "До кожного листа можна прикріпити до 1024 вкладень, однак пам'ятайте, що загальний розмір листа разом з усіма вкладеннями не повинен перевищувати 100 Гб." = up to 1,024 attachments per message, and the total message size including all attachments must not exceed 100 GB. If that figure is real it is the largest per-object cap found anywhere in this niche — 40x Yahoo's APPENDLIMIT and 3x Outlook's SMTP SIZE.

egress.terms: Unmetered by provider; mailbox service, no transfer billing.

tooling: IMAP with app-specific passwords (account password blocked for IMAP since 2020-02-18). probe-verified live: `imap.ukr.net:993` -> `* OK IMAP4 ready` / `* CAPABILITY IMAP4rev1 IDLE ID XLIST NAMESPACE AUTH=PLAIN`. Requires enabling IMAP in settings and generating a per-app password.
chaining: Byte quota per account is not published at all — only the per-message cap. If the 100 GB/message figure holds, a handful of accounts covers 10 TiB; if it is a unit typo the real cap is likely 100 MB and the provider collapses to noise. This needs an authenticated test before it is counted.
limits_note: per-object-cap claimed 100 GB/message (unverified — no APPENDLIMIT in CAPABILITY, so the server may reject below that). Actual mailbox byte quota not published. IMAP requires a generated app password; the account password is refused.
reliability_note: The 100 GB claim is a docs statement with no probe evidence behind it and one plausible unit error (Гб vs Мб); do not size anything against it until an authenticated APPEND succeeds.

evidence.proved: "до 1024 вкладень ... не повинен перевищувати 100 Гб", read live 2026-10-21
IMAP enabled + app password required since 2020-02-18
